newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in dull after-hours trade on Friday, as the effect of the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar was offset by weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan, traders said.

Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kilogram lower to 0.6 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark May was 0.3 yen weaker at 142.5 yen. During the day, prices drifted within narrow ranges in directionless trade.
"We are watching to see if Thai rubber offer prices to Japan ease further," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
